close_reason: Stale: find_immutable_patch_key uses const &[&str] linear scan, not OnceLock<HashSet>. doc at helpers.rs:83 already explains the design.
description: find_immutable_patch_key uses a OnceLock<HashSet> for O(1) exact match, but then calls IMMUTABLE_EMAIL_FIELDS.iter().copied().find() — a linear scan over the same slice — to return the &'static str. The HashSet already contains the &'static str pointers from the array; the find() is redundant. Suggested rewrite: change the HashSet to HashSet<&'static str> and return the value directly from the set: if let Some(&f) = set.get(key.as_str()) { return Some(f); }
title: find_immutable_patch_key: redundant linear scan after O(1) HashSet hit
